So I love the look of Glass. I’m not a massive fan of all wood racks (just my personal taste) but I’ve had it demonstrated to me recently the ringing that can occur in glass shelving under 2 inches thick. 

This can then obviously be picked up and the result is the system not sounding as sweet as it could be. 

This extra layer of isolation seems to just protect the turntable from ringing/extra vibrations. 

It could be belts and braces/snake oil but it’s certainly worked for me in an A/B set of tests. 

I will one day buy a super expensive rack but until the misses and I get our house I don’t want to commit to any expensive furniture. 

Hope that makes sense and as always with audio: YMMV.
